fields.why: The Summary's headline claim is bivalent booster vs 2–4 monovalent doses only (Ref), a two-group contrast, so pair leads; age and time-since-dose estimates are each against that same Ref, and the age-group similarity is a side-by-side aside.

The article is silent on clustering; the unit is the test, and only tests within 90 days of a prior positive are excluded, so repeated tests per person or site clustering are not ruled out. Silent gives null, not none.
